selection.criteria: Primary publisher/proceedings, original author or institution page, or original dataset deposit; existence and relevant claim independently inspectable. Do not transfer reported numerical accuracy to RealHyFC.

excluded_or_not_retained.title: Long-term dynamic durability test datasets for single proton exchange membrane fuel cell
excluded_or_not_retained.reason: Different Tongji single-cell dataset of approximately 1008 hours, not RealHyFC; no use as experimental data.

excluded_or_not_retained.title: Spatially Resolved Current Density and Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy in PEM Fuel Cells
excluded_or_not_retained.reason: Related initial characterization dataset, not the durability Loadcycle source required here.

excluded_or_not_retained.title: Recursive and direct multi-step forecasting: the best of both worlds
excluded_or_not_retained.reason: Author working paper verified, but replaced in final included set by the peer-reviewed 2010 multiple-output primary study; no rectify/residual-head modification in this round.

verification.method: web search plus original publisher/proceedings/dataset or author/institution pages; DOI strings matched to titles on original records
verification.semantic_scholar: S2-API-UNAVAILABLE: browser open of the DOI lookup endpoint was inaccessible; graceful fallback to primary web sources. No S2 identity or match claimed.
verification.doi_gateway_limit: Several doi.org redirects returned 403/500 in the browsing tool. The corresponding titles and DOI strings were checked on original publisher or original deposit records; successful HTTP DOI resolution is not claimed for those gateways.
verification.full_text_limit: Pathapati 2005 and Ben Taieb 2010 were checked through original publisher abstracts and section excerpts, not subscription full text. RealHyFC journal claims here use the original-author deposit abstract, dataset description and project publication page. Pukrushpan author PDF and TFT author preprint HTML were inspected.

claims.claim_text: The RealHyFC deposit explicitly provides load cycle data, polarization and EIS data; local completeness is a separate P0 question.
Current changes interact with gas supply, pressures, water and thermal dynamics, supporting examination of causal operating inputs rather than interpreting all voltage transients as aging.
Known future inputs must be distinguished from observed-only inputs; a recorded future current setpoint is not proof of a preavailable plan.
A vector of direct multiple-output forecasts is distinct from recursive feedback and from one separately trained scalar model per horizon.
Persistence is a necessary reference and event/target imbalance is a candidate diagnosis, not evidence that a new module will improve RealHyFC.

negative_constraints: No F2 superiority or numerical RMSE claim without actual experiment files.
No change to first-round loss, gate or model modules.
No use of held-out historical events to set new thresholds.
No 30-second versus historical 12-hour accuracy comparison as improvement evidence.

sources.title: Underlying data of the paper Spatially Resolved Electrochemical Characterization of a PEM Fuel Cell Stack During Durability Testing
sources.verified_locator: Description; Files; Published June 29 2026, version v1
sources.supports: Correct durability dataset provenance and the inclusion of Loadcycle_data.zip, polarization, sensitivity and EIS resources.
sources.does_not_support: Exact local CSV count, complete Git LFS hydration, exact 1 second sampling everywhere, validated forecasting accuracy or failure-time labels.
sources.conflict_assessment: Original data authors describe their own dataset; independent external replication not assessed.

sources.title: Spatially resolved electrochemical characterization of a PEM fuel cell stack during durability testing
sources.supports: Heavy-duty load cycling over 2000 hours; pressure, stoichiometry and spatial differences materially affect electrochemical behavior.
sources.does_not_support: 30/120 second prediction metrics, F2 superiority, all transients being degradation, or local U6 validity.
sources.claim_fitness_grade: A for the experimental source; B for transfer to a different forecasting question
sources.conflict_assessment: Project participants and material suppliers are disclosed; no independent replication or exhaustive COI audit performed.

sources.title: Control-Oriented Modeling and Analysis for Automotive Fuel Cell Systems
sources.venue: Journal of Dynamic Systems, Measurement, and Control, 126(1), 14-25
sources.supports: Compressor, manifold, partial-pressure and membrane-humidity dynamics affect fuel-cell voltage; stack temperature treated as a slower parameter in this model.
sources.does_not_support: A quantitatively calibrated RealHyFC simulator, exact raw data event thresholds, or seconds-level forecasting RMSE. Authors explicitly note inability to completely validate against test data.
sources.evidence_level: III-equivalent engineering computational model with validation limitations
sources.conflict_assessment: Author institutional paper verified; no exhaustive financial COI audit performed.

sources.title: A new dynamic model for predicting transient phenomena in a PEM fuel cell system
sources.verified_locator: Abstract; Introduction; Model validation and simulation excerpts
sources.supports: A dynamic model can include double-layer capacitance, flow/pressure, mass and heat transfer, with voltage response to sudden load-current changes.
sources.does_not_support: Identifying double-layer mechanisms from 1 Hz measurements alone, transferring parameters to RealHyFC, or asserting a 300 second optimum.
sources.evidence_level: III, computational model with reported laboratory comparison
sources.claim_fitness_grade: B for mechanism with abstract-only quantitative limitations
sources.conflict_assessment: Publisher excerpt discloses US Army, Connecticut Global Fuel Cell Center and university foundation support; exhaustive COI audit not performed.

sources.title: Delving into Deep Imbalanced Regression
sources.venue: Proceedings of the 38th International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 139, 11842-11851
sources.supports: Continuous-target imbalance deserves dedicated diagnosis; label/feature distribution smoothing were evaluated on several non-PEMFC tasks.
sources.does_not_support: A time-causal event predictor, temporal-event labeling from future data at inference, or automatic improvement of F2/RealHyFC through reweighting. No adopted algorithm in this first trial.
sources.claim_fitness_grade: B for imbalance diagnosis; C for transfer to seconds-level voltage events
sources.conflict_assessment: Author/proceedings identity verified; no exhaustive funding/COI audit performed.

sources.title: Temporal Fusion Transformers for interpretable multi-horizon time series forecasting
sources.verified_locator: Author version section 3 Multi-horizon Forecasting; section 2 Related Work
sources.supports: Explicit distinction among static, observed-only and future-known covariates; simultaneously outputs multiple future steps.
sources.does_not_support: Recorded future setpoints being available at the forecast origin, TFT/F2 equivalence, or F2 superiority on RealHyFC. Author preprint and final article are one source, not two independent results.
sources.claim_fitness_grade: A for information-set definition; B for transfer to this study
sources.conflict_assessment: Google and Oxford affiliations and internship noted; no independent replication/COI audit performed.

sources.title: Forecasting: Principles and Practice, third edition, online version accessed 2026-10-21
sources.verified_locator: Sections 5.2 Naive method, 5.8 Evaluating point forecast accuracy, 5.10 Time series cross-validation
sources.supports: Last-observation naive forecast; evaluation on genuinely future observations and chronological rolling origins.
sources.does_not_support: Persistence optimality for PEMFC, one fixed train split percentage or numerical accuracy on the present dataset.
sources.claim_fitness_grade: A for naive-method definition; not experimental evidence
sources.conflict_assessment: Textbook authors present their own methodology reference; no independent peer-review status inferred.

sources.title: Multiple-output modeling for multi-step-ahead time series forecasting
sources.verified_locator: Abstract; Introduction; Multi-step-ahead prediction techniques excerpt
sources.supports: Distinction between iterated, scalar direct and multiple-output forecasting; one MIMO model predicts a future value vector without target feedback.
sources.does_not_support: Guaranteed horizon-to-horizon dynamics, optimality on RealHyFC, or a direct comparison of 30 second and historical 12 hour errors.
sources.evidence_level: III, controlled computational benchmark on NN3
sources.claim_fitness_grade: A for terminology; B for method transfer
sources.conflict_assessment: Publisher and author university metadata checked; exhaustive funding/COI audit not performed.

limitations: Targeted quick search, no exhaustive database export, no PRISMA claim or fabricated hit counts.
Some original papers inspected at abstract/excerpt level only.
Primary web verification is not the on-disk original-file acquisition attestation used by the skill trust-chain fields.
Literature does not establish present experiment results or optimal settings; integrate P0-P3 results before final study conclusion.
